definition.name: density_matrix
definition.definition: A density matrix (or quantum state) rho on a d-dimensional Hilbert space C^d is a d×d positive semidefinite Hermitian matrix with trace 1: rho >= 0, tr(rho) = 1. A state is 'pure' if rho = |psi><psi| for some unit vector |psi> in C^d (equivalently, rank(rho) = 1). A state is 'mixed' if it is not pure (rank > 1). The rank of rho is denoted r = rank(rho).
